content.text: You’ve been rejected by Stripe. Again. Your PayPal account is frozen. Your customers in Zimbabwe cannot pay you. Conventional platforms are not an option. You need infrastructure you own—not rent. Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and R2 provide the foundation. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-one-afternoon-fast|payment]]s handles crypto payments without KYC. This is not a workaround. It is a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-3|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-3|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce stack. Deploy it today. Own it forever. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Your store runs on infrastructure you control. This guide walks you through deploying the Edge Commerce Stack. Step by step. From backend to payment layer. From testnet to mainnet. From zero to live store.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms fail you because they are not built for your context. Stripe and PayPal require stable currencies and compliant banking systems. Your environment does not meet their criteria. Cloudflare Pages and Workers, however, are infrastructure primitives. They do not care about your location or currency. They serve static sites and run backend logic globally. NOWPayments processes crypto payments on-chain. No buyer account required. No KYC. The payment layer verifies transactions automatically via webhook. File delivery happens through Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Order data is stored in Supabase. You own every component. No single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. This stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe. It works when everything else fails.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and your digital products. Sign up for Cloudflare. It’s free. Create a NOWPayments account. Choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Organize them into folders. Name them clearly. You will map these to product IDs later. If you have an existing domain, configure it in Cloudflare DNS. If not, use the free Cloudflare Pages subdomain. Install the Wrangler CLI for local Worker development. Install Google Apps Script if you prefer it over Workers. You do not need coding expertise. The Edge Commerce Stack includes templates. Follow the deployment guide. Every step is documented.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy the backend first. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are faster and more scalable. Apps Script is simpler. Choose based on your needs. Configure the payment layer second. Integrate NOWPayments using their API key and secret. Set the webhook URL to your Worker or Apps Script endpoint. Test the payment flow on testnet. Ensure the webhook fires correctly. Map product IDs to file URLs in your delivery pipeline. Use Cloudflare R2 for high-volume stores. Use Google Drive for simpler setups. The Edge Commerce Stack includes pre-built templates for both. Deploy them with one command. The backend handles order storage in Supabase. It generates secure download links. It sends confirmation emails. You configure the email templates. You set the payment thresholds. You own the logic.
The entire sovereign stack — hosting, payments, delivery, order storage — has zero monthly cost after the one-time deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Connect your custom domain or use the free subdomain. Test the entire flow end-to-end. Simulate a purchase on testnet. Verify the payment webhook fires. Check that the download link is generated. Ensure the order is stored in Supabase. Once confirmed, switch to mainnet. Promote your store. Share the link with your audience. Monitor transactions in your Supabase dashboard. Track file downloads in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support. Use it to troubleshoot issues. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. Your second transaction proves it scales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your store is live. Your infrastructure is sovereign. Now scale it. Add more products. Increase your marketing. The backend handles the load. Cloudflare Workers auto-scale. Supabase manages order data efficiently. File delivery is handled by R2 or Drive. Monitor transaction fees. Optimize by switching networks in NOWPayments. BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack includes a scaling playbook. Follow it to grow your store. You are not renting this infrastructure. You own it. No platform can limit you. No currency collapse can stop you. Your store runs on base-layer primitives. It is built to last.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free works by leveraging Cloudflare’s free hosting, Workers for backend logic, R2 for file delivery, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. This stack eliminates dependency on Stripe or PayPal. It is designed for regions where conventional platforms are unavailable. You own the infrastructure after deployment. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a complete solution. It includes templates, documentation, and 30-day support. Deploy it today. Own your commerce infrastructure.
Test a real mainnet transaction before you promote — finding a configuration error with your own crypto costs less than finding it with a buyer's.

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is the complete solution for deploying this infrastructure. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. Your store is deployed in 48 hours. Five products are loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC is configured. End-to-end testing is included. You own the stack after deployment. No ongoing fees. No platform dependency. It is built for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Purchase it here: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for Cloudflare and NOWPayments. Choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 2. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Organize them into folders. 3. Install Wrangler CLI for Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. 4. Deploy the backend using the Edge Commerce Stack templates. Configure the payment layer with NOWPayments. 5. Test the payment flow on testnet. Verify the webhook fires correctly. 6. Map product IDs to file URLs in your delivery pipeline. 7. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. Connect your custom domain or use the free subdomain. 8. Test the entire flow end-to-end. Simulate a purchase. Verify order storage and file delivery. 9. Switch to mainnet. Promote your store to your audience. 10. Monitor transactions and scale your store using the included playbook.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use my own domain with Cloudflare Pages?
Yes. Configure your domain in Cloudflare DNS. Point it to your Cloudflare Pages project. The Edge Commerce Stack includes DNS setup instructions.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10.
Follow the setup sequence in order: backend first, payment layer second, mainnet test third, promote fourth.
